title: Plan of action and milestones, field guide
author: EasyRMM

sections.heading: What each item records
sections.body:
The requirement that is not met.
What is wrong, in plain words.
The points the requirement is worth.
Who owns the fix and what it needs.
The steps, each with a date.
The date by which the item must be closed, 180 days after it is opened.
